original_text: Yes!!! to advisory council

FYI. SCC is not available for 2 weeks to troubleshoot a client issue impacting the distribution of weather information. I guess ensuring Canadians have accurate weather information is not a priority for Shared Services. ECCC has people working 24x7 to generate accurate information, but shared services cannot make sure it is distributed correctly? Seems a disconnect here.
